caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a central circular motif at the bottom, which is filled with a geometric, mandala-like pattern that includes alternating petal and pointed shapes in light brown, red, and blue colors. Above the circle, there are two stylized, wing-like shapes in light brown, each ending in three rounded points with red tips. Above the wings, a bow shape is depicted with four loops outlined in blue and filled with red and gold patterns, converging at a central circular knot with an blue and red design. At the top of the composition, there is an ornate cross outlined in red and filled with light brown, with blue line accents and yellow rays emanating from its sides. The entire drawing is set against a textured, parchment-like background in beige, giving it an aged appearance.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
